context: TCGTracking has no way to mark an order shipped, and the tracking number it returns is masked.

options.gain: Nothing is built on a guess.
options.how: You keep marking orders shipped as today. Decide after the first live lookup shows whether the full number comes back.
options.label: You, for now; decide later
options.lose: A manual step stays for now.

options.how: Banchi writes tracking to TCGplayer as part of this build.
options.label: Banchi, in this lane
options.lose: It is built on an unknown: the number may be masked.

title: Who tells TCGplayer an order shipped?
why: The full tracking number is unproven until the first live lookup.
